verdict.rationale: Statsig ingests and stores event and exposure data, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for it. The evidence pack never documents retention periods, retention settings, or user or event data deletion. The nearby items do not count: CLI/Console API deletion of configs is a different feature, and Warehouse Native running analysis in your own warehouse is adjacent, not retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
